answer: A valley stays honest when every new identity must restore a distinct hollow relic bell in a different ruined chapel, polishing its bronze and ringing it at dawn while a warden counts each chime. The first fake owes one chime-hour, the second three, the third six, since the nth fake owes the triangular number of its count, so the tenth fake alone owes fifty-five chime-hours and twenty fakes owe two hundred and ten. Bulk farming fails because one restorer can polish only one bell at a time and each bell must be rung in sequence at dawn, like one founder casting one bell per furnace firing.
